questions.question: Find the equation of the circle with diameter endpoints A(1,2) and B(5,6). Find the tangent at A.

points.text: Centre = midpoint of AB = (3,4). Radius = half of AB = ½sqrt((5-1)^2+(6-2)^2) = ½sqrt32 = 2sqrt2. Circle: (x-3)^2+(y-4)^2=8. Gradient of radius OA = (2-4)/(1-3)=1. Tangent gradient = -1. Tangent at A: y-2 = -1(x-1) -> y = -x+3
